title: Route-owned dashboard navigation
statement: The dashboard MUST expose primary sections as browser-history-backed pages/routes instead of button-only React section state and in-page scrolling.

title: Route-derived active content state
statement: The dashboard MUST derive selected topic, active major section, active document kind, and route-visible navigation state from TanStack Router path/search state rather than component-only section/tab state.

title: Addressable topic review surfaces
statement: Each major topic review surface MUST be addressable without requiring users to scroll through unrelated content, preserving selected topic context and missing-artifact states.

title: Themed evidence/reference popovers
statement: Rendered Markdown reference links MUST show a themed dashboard hover/focus popover with resolved or missing reference details instead of relying on native browser title tooltips.

title: Complete Mermaid rendering
statement: Rendered Markdown MUST render mermaid code fences through the official Mermaid renderer, supporting all current Mermaid diagram types and features exposed by Mermaid rather than a hand-written subset.

title: Preserve read-only and private-safe guarantees
statement: Dashboard navigation, Markdown reference popovers, and Mermaid rendering MUST remain read-only and MUST NOT expose raw private planning inputs, outside-root files, unsafe file URLs, or dashboard mutation paths.

title: Regression coverage for navigation and Markdown UX
statement: Implementation MUST add or update tests for route deep links, browser history, refresh-safe pages, active route state, Markdown reference popovers, Mermaid registry coverage, type safety, and dashboard build/runtime behavior.

title: Reviewer opens a topic graph directly
Back and Forward restore previous dashboard pages
Keyboard user inspects an evidence reference
Documentation page contains multiple Mermaid diagram types
Direct routes show major dashboard/topic content
Browser Back and Forward restore route-owned content
Reference popovers replace native title tooltips
Read-only and private-safe behavior remains intact
